q: You are walking up a natural pile of earth that is much smaller than a mountain, near Tashkent.
why: «natural pile of earth that is much smaller than a mountain» деgani «hill» (tepalik).

wrong.ocean: «ocean» ulkan okean ma'nosini beradi, bu kichik tepalikka mos kelmaydi.
wrong.volcano: «volcano» otilib chiquvchi vulqonni bildiradi, bu yerda bunday holat yo'q.
wrong.cliff: «cliff» tik qoyani anglatadi, bu esa tepalik emas.

q: Water is falling from a high place over rocks into a pool below.
why: «Water is falling from a high place» degani «waterfall» (sharshara).

wrong.desert: «desert» qurg'oq cho'l bo'lib, suv oqishiga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
wrong.lake: «lake» turg'un ko'l suvini anglatadi, oqib tushmaydi.

q: This is a very dry, hot area of land with almost no water or trees.
why: «very dry, hot area of land with almost no water» degani «desert» (cho'l).

wrong.river: «river» daryo bo'lib, unda suv ko'p bo'ladi.
wrong.valley: «valley» vodiyni anglatadi, u odatda cho'l emas.

q: It is a large area of land covered thickly with many trees and plants.
why: «covered thickly with many trees» degani «forest» (o'rmon).

q: You are standing on the ground right next to the sea, where the land meets the water.
why: «where the land meets the water» degani «shore» (qirg'oq).

q: This is a very tall, high mass of rock and earth that reaches high up into the sky.
why: «very tall, high mass of rock» degani «mountain» (tog').

q: It is a natural underground room or space in the side of a hill or cliff.
why: «natural underground room» degani «cave» (g'or).

q: This is a steep, vertical wall of rock, often standing right above the sea.
why: «steep, vertical wall of rock» degani «cliff» (tik qoya).

q: It is a large, flowing body of natural water moving across the land to the sea.
why: «large, flowing body of natural water» degani «river» (daryo).

q: This is a very small, narrow river that is easy to step across.
why: «very small, narrow river» degani «stream» (jilg'a).

wrong.ocean: «ocean» ulkan okean bo'lib, uning ustidan hatlab o'tib bo'lmaydi.

q: It is a huge area of salty water that covers most of the Earth's surface.
why: «huge area of salty water» degani «ocean» (okean).

wrong.lake: «lake» ko'l bo'lib, odatda chuchuk suvli va kichikroq.

q: This is a large, inland body of fresh or salt water completely surrounded by land.
why: «surrounded by land» degani «lake» (ko'l).

q: It is a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.
why: «low area of land between hills or mountains» degani «valley» (vodiy).

q: This is a mountain that has a hole at the top where fire, ash, and hot liquid rock can burst out.
why: «mountain that has a hole at the top» degani «volcano» (vulqon).

q: These are hard, solid pieces of stone that you can find on the ground or in the mountains.
why: «hard, solid pieces of stone» degani «rocks» (toshlar).

q: You cannot see anything in this room because there is no light at all.
why: «no light at all» degani «dark» (qorong'i).

q: The ocean trench is very ______; humans cannot swim to the bottom without special machines.
why: «humans cannot swim to the bottom» so'zi «deep» (chuqur) ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.shallow: «shallow» sayoz degani, bu yerda to'g'ri kelmaydi.

q: The door is too ______ for the big sofa to fit through; we need a wider entrance.
why: «big sofa to fit through» va «wider entrance» ishorasi «narrow» (tor) so'ziga ishora.

wrong.wide: «wide» keng, lekin jumlada divan sig'mayotgani aytilmoqda.

q: You can touch the riverbed easily because the water is very ______ here.
why: «You can touch the riverbed easily» qismi «shallow» (sayoz) ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.deep: «deep» chuqur bo'lsa, tubiga teginish qiyin bo'lardi.

q: My older brother is very ______; he is almost two meters in height.
why: «almost two meters in height» iborasi «tall» (baland/bo'yi uzun) so'zini anglatadi.
